basic.name: 普通攻击：捷击
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：噬爪
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方快速来回穿刺，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a rapid back-and-forth piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：噬爪·瞬步
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方多次来回穿刺，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Pierce back and forth times, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：睚眦必报
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突刺并衔接快速斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, then follow up with a swift slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：嗨，想不到吧
chain.nameEn: Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方发动蓄力射击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a charged shot forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：噢，游戏时间
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方大范围敌人发动强力射击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleash a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：雇佣合同·保镖业务
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突刺并衔接快速斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, followed by rapid slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 回避支援：雇佣合同·作战外包
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：单独计价
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前腾空跃起后开枪射击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时，将消耗1点[支援点数]，使自身进入[猎步]状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Leap forward into the air and fire, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 1 Assist Point to enter the Hunter's Gait state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 波可娜发动[强化特殊技]、[支援突击]、[连携技]、[终结技]时，将会进入[猎步]状态，使自身造成的失衡值提升15%，持续6秒；切换至其他角色后，若波可娜仍处于[猎步]状态下，则其持续时间会改为切换回波可娜时；进入[猎步]状态后，自身为当前操作中的角色时，波可娜重击命中敌人，能够触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]。
facts.textEn: When Pulchra activates an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Hunter's Gait state, increasing the Daze she deals by 15% for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the Hunter's Gait state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the Hunter's Gait state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a Quick Assist from the previous character in the squad.

facts.text: 波可娜发动[强化特殊技]、[支援突击]、[连携技]、[终结技]时，将会进入[猎步]状态，使自身造成的失衡值提升30%，持续6秒；切换至其他角色后，若波可娜仍处于[猎步]状态下，则其持续时间会改为切换回波可娜时；进入[猎步]状态后，自身为当前操作中的角色时，波可娜重击命中敌人，能够触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]。
facts.textEn: When Pulchra activates an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Hunter's Gait state, increasing the Daze she deals by 30% for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the Hunter's Gait state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the Hunter's Gait state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a Quick Assist from the previous character in the squad.

cinema.name: 利己主义
cinema.description: 对被施加[困迹]效果的敌人造成伤害时，自身暴击率提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by Binding Trap, increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.

cinema.description: 处于[核心被动：猎手本能]的[猎步]状态时，波可娜的攻击力额外提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Hunter's Gait state from Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct, Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.

cinema.name: 领地意识
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2

cinema.descriptionEn: Reduces Energy Cost of activating EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep by 5.

cinema.description: [特殊技：噬爪·噩梦袭影]造成的伤害提升15%，重复攻击的可触发次数额外提升2次；[额外能力：业务搭档]中[困迹]的效果对[追加攻击]以外的伤害类型也会生效。
cinema.descriptionEn: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. Additional Ability: Business Partner's Binding Trap effect now also applies to all damage types, not just Aftershock DMG.

ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow
ex.description:
波可娜进入[猎步]状态后，队伍中其他操作中的角色的[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]重击命中敌人时触发：
围绕目标敌人，快速来回穿刺，造成物理伤害；
招式发动后，队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动任意攻击命中敌人时，波可娜会重复发动攻击，最多额外触发5次，且最后一次攻击会被替换为更加强力的终结一击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
[特殊技：噬爪·噩梦袭影]为[追加攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
While Pulchra is in the Hunter's Gait state, and when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with a heavy attack from a Special Attack or EX Special Attack:
Dash back-and-forth piercing enemies centered on the target, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, if another active character in the squad hits an enemy, Pulchra will repeat the attack up to 5 additional times, with the final attack being a more powerful Finishing Move.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow is an Aftershock attack.
